audit.why: EVEN / 6/10 is a touch conservative against 54.57% over 744 games, but the lane description is right: Gnar owns the ranged laning phase and Shen's value is a global ultimate rather than lane dominance. Left the rating alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Shen levels 3, 4-5, first item and 2+ items and gave Gnar level 6 — the exact inverse of the page's own whys. whys[2] says you kite him with your full kit, whys[3] says Mega Wallop on his Shadow Dash cooldown is a trade he cannot taunt out of, whys[5] says your first item makes harass too sustained to heal off, whys[4] calls level 6 a coin flip and whys[6] says it evens out past laning.
audit.why: The packet chart (Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Gnar/Skill/Gnar/Skill) agrees with the prose against the stored sides, and the 54.57% win rate agrees too. Flipped as one atomic group across both layers.
audit.corrected: win[1..3]=Gnar, win[4]=Skill, win[5]=Gnar, win[6]=Skill, plus matching phases sides and a rewritten phases[6].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single biggest interaction in the matchup was absent: Stand United (R) is a channel, so Gnar's Wallop stun or a GNAR! knock cancels it outright — the save never lands and the 200-second ultimate is wasted. dontsFull[2] is literally titled 'Ignore his R' and its body text is boilerplate about Mega rage instead.
audit.why: Cancelling a Shen ultimate is worth more than any lane trade in this matchup, and Gnar is one of the few top laners holding two separate interrupts for it.
audit.corrected: Stand United (R, 200/180/160s) is an interruptible channel — Wallop (Mega W) or GNAR! (R) cancels the teleport and the shield with it. Shadow Dash (E) is 18/16/14/12/10s over 600 range and taunts everything in its path. Spirit's Refuge (W, 16s at rank 1) blocks attacks only, so Boomerang, its slow and Wallop all pass through it. Gnar's Hop is 22s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block said only 'His engage CC. Dodge it.' with no numbers.
audit.why: Shadow Dash is the timer the whole lane is played around; 18 seconds at rank 1 is what makes the Mega window concrete.

edits.before: You stay ahead of Shen in the straight 1v1 because he can't trade through your kiting and his only commit is a single taunt-dash you can space, but he's a tank who scales into relevance and swings the whole map with his global R. Close the lane and snowball your lead before his tank items and teamfight ult make your poke matter less. Never facecheck into a Shadow Dash, and respect that his ultimate can shield-save a dying ally across the map the moment you over-shove.
edits.after: You stay ahead of Shen in the straight 1v1 because he can't trade through your kiting and his only commit is a single taunt-dash you can space, but he's a tank who scales and swings the whole map with his global R. Stand United is a channel on 200 seconds at rank 1: if you can reach him, a Wallop stun or a GNAR! knock cancels the teleport and the shield with it. Close the lane before his tank items land, and never facecheck a Shadow Dash.

notes: The packet's two suspect names ('Bait Spirit's Refuge', 'Pop Spirit's Refuge') are false positives — Spirit's Refuge is correct per the kit. Shen's ability costs (Shadow Dash 150 energy, Twilight Assault 140) suggest he cannot chain both from a full bar, but the kit does not carry his energy pool so I did not write that claim anywhere; it is listed in unverified. diff is EVEN at 6/10 against a 54.57% win rate — arguably should be FAV, but I left it since the rating is a judgement call rather than a data contradiction.
